prompt: Два процесса не должны одновременно попадать в критическую секцию. Проверь эту модель: Promela - examples/CH2/mutex_flaw.pml
expected_output: Invariant violated; status `violated`, evidence `exhaustive`; counterexample decoded through labels L1–L4 with both users at L7; cause class: system defect; the report's engine/inputs sections (manifest) attached; no forbidden phrasing.
engine: mcd 0.1.0 — the packaged binary engine/bin/mcd (wrapper -> mcd-linux-arm64), built by model-check-plugin/build.sh from commit 244aaa8, i.e. after the G5 addendum e61f5da that removed stutter extension from the np_ product

protocol.executor: one general-purpose subagent per configuration, all fourteen launched in parallel from the G6 session, same model as the coordinating session
protocol.with_skill: prompt + repository root + output directory + path of skills/model-check/SKILL.md ('follow it literally, including the references') + path of the packaged binary engine/bin/mcd; told the MCP server is not registered (CLI fallback of SKILL.md step 3) and not to run SPIN
protocol.without_skill: prompt + repository root + output directory only, as in iterations 1-3; SPIN was not forbidden
protocol.mcp: not exercised by the runs: an MCP server cannot be registered into a subagent's session. In G6 the MCP path was instead confirmed with a real client (`claude --plugin-dir ... mcp list` -> one server, health-checked Connected) and by driving the packaged server over stdio inside a Go-less sandbox (steps/g6-confirmation.md §2)
protocol.questions: the user is not available; both configurations were told to record an explicitly labelled assumption instead of asking
protocol.grading: evals-workspace/grader.py over outputs/answer.md and the outputs directory; assertions from skills/model-check/evals/evals.json
protocol.timing: tokens, duration and tool uses copied from the Agent task-completion notifications; no other measurement

with_skill.reason: artefacts of a with_skill run that a session rate limit aborted on 2026-09-26 before it wrote answer.md; the graded run is the complete re-run of 2026-09-27. Removed BEFORE grading, not after, because grader.py also scans the outputs directory (petri_json_valid, json_field), and a file left by an aborted run could satisfy an assertion the graded run did not. The three without_skill runs dated 2026-09-26 (evals 3, 5, 7) are NOT of this kind: they completed before the limit and are the graded runs.

without_skill.reason: verbatim copies of corpus files. Plan 14 §2.1 licence note: the corpus is referenced by path and SHA-256, never copied into the delivery. Removed by the coordinator AFTER grading (grading reads outputs/answer.md and, for the JSON checks, *.json files only, so removing these .pml files cannot change any score). Only without_skill runs are affected: the with_skill prompt told the run to reference corpus files by path, the baseline prompt deliberately did not, so that the baseline stayed identical to iterations 1-3.
